description: EC2 Account-Level IMDSv2 Default Not Required
rationale: The regional account default is explicitly optional or no-preference and HttpTokensEnforced is disabled. This permits launch-time IMDSv1 configurations; it is not proof that currently running EC2 instances use IMDSv1.
remediation: After testing AMI and application compatibility, set HttpTokens=required at account/Region scope and consider enforcing IMDSv2. Audit instance-level overrides separately.
